caption: This is a bowl of miso ramen with a rich, orange broth. Topped with menma, shredded cabbage, and chopped green onions, it sits in a white ceramic bowl with a blue rim, under warm lighting, with a spoon resting beside it.

segments_info.text: Black textured table surface with subtle grid pattern and faint white paper edge visible.
The miso broth is orange, creamy, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly translucent, with curved, layered shapes and visible fibrous texture.
White ceramic bowl with blue rim stripes, smooth glossy surface, slightly curved edges, and subtle glaze reflections.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and faint yellowish stain near its tip.
